Requested updates for this PR:

This doc lists the cleanup each area needs, one task per area. All findings were checked against origin/main at 1a6a393a.
#	Task	Area	Priority
1	Remove stray repo-root files	Repo hygiene	High
2	Remove personal Claude agents and skills	Repo hygiene	High
3	Remove Visualizer packaging leftovers	Packaging	Medium
4	Stop vendoring the Model Explorer `worker.js`	Packaging, licensing	Medium
5	Merge ModelUtils into the Visualizer package	Architecture	Medium
6	Tighten the source-fetch layer	Architecture, security	Medium
7	Fix the coverage gate on pushes to main	CI	High
8	Close CI trigger and merge-gate gaps	CI	Low
9	Build each real model once, pinned	Tests	High
10	Delete coverage-padding tests	Tests	Medium
11	Consolidate per-bugfix test files	Tests	Medium
12	Remove tripwire assertions	Tests	Medium
13	Move misfiled ModelUtils unit tests	Tests	Low
14	Replace vendored model fixtures	Tests, licensing	High
15	Fix stale references	Docs	Low
---
1. Remove stray repo-root files
Problem
`coverage.json` (1.0 MB) is a coverage.py report from a local run dated 2026-08-07: 106 files, mostly `TraceLens/Agent`, at 26%. Nothing references it.
`probe_gate_venvs.py` (596 lines) is a personal dev-loop driver. It calls `probe_gate_reconciled.py` and cites `probe_digest.py` and `probe_label_hist.py`, none of which are in the repo, so it fails on a clean checkout. It hardcodes per-model node counts and a running log of commit SHAs. No CI job, doc or test references it.
Fix
Delete both files.
Add `coverage.json` to `.gitignore` next to `coverage.xml`.
Done when neither file is tracked and `git grep -e probe_gate -e coverage.json` returns only the `.gitignore` entry.
2. Remove personal Claude agents and skills
Problem
Seven files hardcode the author's machine (`/home/AMD/gabweisz/venv_tracelens_visualizer/bin/python`, `/home/AMD/gabweisz/huggingface`) and reference a `_linear_attn_graph.py` that is not in the repo:
`.claude/agents/graph-integrity-fix.md`, `graph-type-fix.md`, `opaque-node-audit.md`
`.claude/skills/check-dead-nodes/`, `check-graph-integrity/`, `check-graph-shapes/`, `check-graph-types/`
Fix
Delete all seven. A tracked `.claude/` is fine in itself (`review-pr` already lives there), so if any check is worth sharing, re-add it later written against `python -m` entry points with no absolute paths.
Done when `git grep gabweisz` is empty.
3. Remove Visualizer packaging leftovers
Problem
These files are leftovers from when the Visualizer was a standalone repo:
File	Issue
`TraceLens/Visualizer/.gitignore`	Nested ignore file (`.venv/`, `*.png`, `*.svg`, `*.pdf`)
`TraceLens/Visualizer/requirements-dev.txt`	Duplicates the `dev` extra; nothing reads it
`TraceLens/Visualizer/visualize_model_in_explorer.py`	11-line shim duplicating the console-script entry point
`TraceLens/Visualizer/requirements.txt`	Read by `setup.py` to build the `Visualizer` extra, but missing from `MANIFEST.in`, so an sdist gets an empty extra
Fix
Delete all four.
Inline the `Visualizer` extra in `setup.py` (`torch`, `transformers`, `huggingface_hub>=0.20`, `triton` on Linux x86_64) and drop `_read_requirements`.
Move the generated-HTML ignore rule, if still needed, into the root `.gitignore`.
Done when `pip install '.[Visualizer]'` from a built sdist installs torch and transformers.
4. Stop vendoring the Model Explorer `worker.js`
Problem
`viewer/worker.js` is a 928 KB minified build of Google's `ai-edge-model-explorer-visualizer` 0.1.2, committed with no license or attribution file.
`package.json` and `package-lock.json` exist only to copy that file out of `node_modules`.
`serve.py:31` and `viewer_page.py:28` also look for `node_modules` at runtime.
`worker.js` ships in `package_data` and the viewer needs it, so it cannot simply be deleted.
Fix
Delete `worker.js`, `package.json` and `package-lock.json`.
Fetch the pinned release on first use (fixed version plus sha256), cache it under `~/.cache/tracelens/`, and serve it from there. Load it from a pinned CDN URL as a fallback for the standalone HTML.
Remove the `node_modules` lookups and the `viewer/*.js` entry from `package_data` (keep `app.js` and `index.html`).
Done when the repo carries no third-party minified JS and a fresh install renders a model.
5. Merge ModelUtils into the Visualizer package
Problem
ModelUtils is the Visualizer's backend presented as a shared library:
Nothing else in TraceLens imports it.
It has no extra or entry point; the `[Visualizer]` extra supplies its torch and transformers.
It imports the Visualizer back (`torch_introspect.py:222-225`), a cycle hidden by two `.importlinter` ignore entries.
`model_env.py:507` names the Visualizer CLI as a string, which the import linter cannot see. `model_env` is only used by the Visualizer CLI's `--auto-venv`.
`github.py` carries Visualizer branding (`User-Agent: TraceLens-Visualizer/0.3`, cache dir `~/.cache/tracelens/visualizer/github`).
`tests/ModelUtils` imports Visualizer modules (`test_discarded_values`, `test_parallel_plan`, `test_torch_introspect`).
Fix
Move `TraceLens/ModelUtils/` under the Visualizer (for example `TraceLens/Visualizer/model_graph/`) and `tests/ModelUtils/` under `tests/Visualizer/`.
Drop the two `torch_introspect -> Visualizer` entries from `.importlinter`.
Merge the `modelutils-tests` and `visualizer-tests` CI jobs.
If a second consumer (PerfModel, Agent) is planned, keep two packages instead:
Move `explorer_graph_from_fx_inventory` and `model_env` into the Visualizer.
Add a `forbidden` import-linter contract so ModelUtils cannot import the Visualizer.
Give ModelUtils its own extra.
Done when `.importlinter` has no ModelUtils/Visualizer ignore entries and `git grep TraceLens.Visualizer -- <backend dir>` is empty.
6. Tighten the source-fetch layer
Problem
`github.fetch_github_source` enforces the `SourcePolicy` allow-list, but `fetch_github_file` does not.
`kernel_pipeline.py:~370` has its own `urllib` fetcher to `raw.githubusercontent.com` instead of using `github.py`.
`kernel_pipeline.py:29` reads `TRACELENS_KERNEL_FIXTURE_ROOT`, a test-only hook in shipped code.
Fix
Route every network fetch through one `github.py` function that checks the policy.
Replace the env-var hook with a parameter or a test monkeypatch.
Done when `git grep urlopen -- <backend dir>` matches only `github.py`, and every public fetch checks the policy.
7. Fix the coverage gate on pushes to main
Problem
On a push to main, the `changes` job can skip `modelutils-tests` or `visualizer-tests`. The `codecov` job still runs `coverage report --fail-under=95` over all of `./TraceLens`, so the skipped packages count as uncovered and the gate fails:
Commit	Change	Skipped	Total
ebc74e91 (#1129)	PerfModel only	both	45%
b6fd72dd (#1151)	one ModelUtils test	visualizer-tests	81%
These are the only two failed Unit Tests runs on main in the last ten. PR runs hide the bug because the gate is skipped for related-test runs.
Fix
Pick one:
Always run both jobs on `push` events (have `changes` output `true` when `EVENT_NAME == push`).
Or pass `--omit` for each skipped package to `coverage report`.
The first is simpler and keeps main's coverage number meaningful.
Done when a push to main that touches neither package passes Codecov.
8. Close CI trigger and merge-gate gaps
Problem
The workflow's `paths` filter does not include `TraceLens/Visualizer/**/*.js` or `*.html`, so viewer changes run no tests.
main has no required status checks, so a failing `visualizer-tests` shard does not block a merge.
Fix
Add the viewer asset globs to the `paths` filter and to the `changes` job's Visualizer prefixes.
Ask a repo admin to mark `Unit Tests` and `Codecov` as required.
Done when a viewer-only PR triggers `visualizer-tests`, and a red shard blocks merge.
9. Build each real model once, pinned
Problem
Every test in the heavy files rebuilds a full real model:
`test_glm53_linear_attn_graph.py` calls `load_model_spec` 72 times and `build_merged_model_graph` 59 times.
`test_loop_invariant_threading.py` makes 37 builds through `_build_nodes` (`:36`).
`test_deepseek_v4_indexer_dead_nodes.py` builds once per test, 12 tests.
That is about 108 builds at 30-45 s each. These three files plus the Kimi file take 89 of the suite's 117 CPU-minutes.
These loads bypass the pinned revision that `model_pins.py` requires:
`test_glm53_*`
`test_loop_invariant_threading.py:37`
`test_operation_labels.py`, seven loads at :20, :28, :195, :218, :321, :361 and :374
`test_fact_sheet.py:89`
`test_matmul_constant_operand_linear.py:110`
`test_buffer_operand_first.py:49` and `test_tuple_parameter_slots.py:49` pin the revision but skip `_require_pinned_transformers`.
`test_loop_invariant_threading.py:144` builds Kimi-K3 in-process, which `conftest.py:9-20` says cannot be done correctly.
The session cache in `conftest.py` lives per xdist worker, so with `-n auto` across 4 shards each model is built many times even when the cache is used.
Fix
Route every real-model test through the `model_graph_nodes` / `kimi_nodes` session fixtures.
Delete the per-file builders.
Persist built graphs to a disk cache keyed by (model, revision, transformers version, regime), so workers and shards share one build. Cache it, plus the `model-envs` directory, with `actions/cache`.
Done when `git grep load_model_spec -- tests/Visualizer` matches only conftest and `build_graph_in_env.py`, and the Visualizer suite runs in about 15-25 CPU-minutes.
10. Delete coverage-padding tests
Problem
Several files exist to hold the 95% coverage gate, not to test behavior:
`test_merge_extra_coverage.py` (1,562 lines) calls itself "extra branch coverage". Its comments cite `merge.py` line numbers, which drift as the code changes.
`test_cli_serve_coverage.py` (867 lines) calls itself "focused branch coverage" and is mostly mocks. Its fact-sheet and URL tests (`:709-830`) duplicate `test_fact_sheet.py`.
About 40% of `test_export_merge_coverage.py` (3,833 lines) is multi-assert tests of private helpers, e.g. `:129` (17 asserts, 18 private calls), `:2189`, `:2242` and `:460`.
`test_graph_type_check.py:916-970` tests private readers.
#1151 added another such file, `tests/ModelUtils/test_meta_trace_coverage.py`.
Fix
Keep the behavior tests: argument validation, pipeline-failure reporting, per-GPU-group output, and the prune, collapse and hoist families.
Delete branch-hit tests.
Fold surviving copy-paste families into parametrized tests (eight `test_fallback_*`, six `test_prune_noop_cast_*`, five `test_collapse_same_name_boundary_*`, five `test_synthesize_loop_boundary_*`).
Rename the files after what they test, not "coverage".
Done when no test file name contains `coverage`, the merged suite is about half its current size, and the gate still passes.
11. Consolidate per-bugfix test files
Problem
About 40 small files each test one merge or type-check rule, and the directory carries about 51 private `_node`/`_tile`/`_attr` builders. Clusters:
Boundary tiles: `boundary_named_for_its_tensor`, `boundary_shape_carry`, `elided_branch_boundary_name`, `entering_tensor_tiles`, `shared_entering_tile` (synthetic half), `mirror_name_qualification`, `section_external_inputs`, `tuple_boundary_split`, `published_port_shapes`, `nullary_op_operands`, `tile_fold_self_redirect`, `group_output_slot_collapse`.
Kernel ports: `kernel_interface_tiles`, `kernel_operand_naming`, `pipeline_box_inputs_named` (synthetic half).
Loops and variants: `loop_body_ends`, `layer_variants_converge`.
Type checks (merge into `test_graph_type_check.py`): `declared_axis_exists`, `declared_rank_holds`, `index_operand_dtype`, `phi_forwards_an_arm`, `projection_width_agreement`, `shape_checks_edge_cases` (36 near-identical tests), `shape_preserving_ops`, `unresolved_config_dims`.
Real-model checks: one file per model (GLM, DeepSeek, MiniMax, Kimi), each reading its session fixture once. `test_hash_router_shapes.py` and `test_module_return_spec.py` (one assert) can be dropped.
Fix
Add one shared synthetic-node builder module.
Merge each cluster into a single parametrized file.
Drop real-model tests that re-assert invariants the build already enforces: `test_glm_has_no_boundary_skips`, `test_no_node_states_a_shape_it_does_not_publish`, `test_dropping_the_constants_orphans_nothing`.
Collapse the four-plus whole-graph "is clean" checks (dead nodes, integrity, type-check, acyclic) into one parametrized test per model. `_assert_export_is_acyclic` alone is pasted into 28 GLM tests.
Done when `tests/Visualizer` is about 15 files and 9-10k lines, down from 51 files and 22k lines.
12. Remove tripwire assertions
Problem
Many assertions pin incidental output, so unrelated upstream or refactor changes break them:
Source-line node ids: `@op_l1319_c85_matmul`, `@op_l758_c27_unsqueeze`, `indexer@l468`. There are about 62 in the GLM file alone.
Exact shapes and dtypes: `[129280, 6] int64`, `[B, S, 96, 128] bfloat16`, `[Img + 1] int32`.
Exact label strings, lists and counts: the `expand_kv` label list, `"loop in: final iterations: 8"`, `93x_KimiDecoderLayer`, and 51 `len(...) == N` asserts in the GLM file.
Torch internals: `test_merge_is_a_name_no_torch_op_uses` reads `_jit_get_all_schemas`.
Dead exemption: `_assert_export_is_acyclic` exempts `@loop_carried_in` ports that other tests in the same file assert no longer exist.
Bug-history docstrings: about 50 GLM tests carry "this used to..." narratives instead of stating the behavior.
Fix
Assert the property (wired, typed, named after its tensor), not the exact id, string or count.
Look nodes up by role, not source line.
Drop the torch-internals test and the dead exemption.
Trim docstrings to one line stating the behavior.
Done when `git grep -E '@op_l[0-9]+' -- tests/Visualizer` is empty.
13. Move misfiled ModelUtils unit tests
Problem
About 400 lines of backend unit tests sit under `tests/Visualizer`:
`test_shape_rules_and_determinism.py` tests `shape_inference` helpers.
`TestTorchDecidesTheClass` in `test_shape_preserving_ops.py`.
`_operand_parameter_bindings` tests in `test_kernel_operand_naming.py`.
AST registry and `computation_graph` tests in `test_return_slot_wiring.py`.
Synthetic AST tests in `test_operation_labels.py`.
Fix
Move them next to the backend's existing tests, merged into matching files. If task 5 lands first, this becomes a move within one test tree.
Done when no file under `tests/Visualizer` tests a backend private helper.
14. Replace vendored model fixtures
Problem
`tests/fixtures/kimi_k3/modeling_kimi_linear.py` (1,445 lines) is vendored Kimi source.
Its header puts non-DeepSeek parts under the "Kimi K3 License (see the LICENSE file in this repository)". That license is not in the repo, and an AMD Apache header sits on top.
Three tests read about 600 lines of it.
`tests/fixtures/kda_kernel/fla/ops/kda/*.py` (679 lines) carries an MIT notice from fla whose LICENSE is not vendored.
`kimi_k3/config.json` is a 251-line full HF config dump. `configuration_kimi_k3.py` is never imported. `kimi_moe_gate.py` duplicates `KimiMoEGate`.
Fix
Replace the Kimi file with a hand-written 150-200 line mini decoder: delta attention, MLA, and MoE or MLP variants.
Replace the kda tree with a 30-40 line `chunk_kda` stub that calls the same four functions.
Trim the config to the keys the tests read (about 20 lines).
Delete the unused stub and the duplicate gate.
Done when `tests/fixtures` carries no third-party source or license text and the dependent tests pass.
15. Fix stale references
Problem
`test_model_pins.py:213` tells readers to edit `TraceLens/ModelUtils/model_pins.py`. The file is `tests/model_pins.py`.
`model_pins.py` says "four-model gate" but lists six pins; `gpt2` appears unused.
`test_deepseek_v4_indexer_dead_nodes.py` now tests rotary, masked_fill and kernel shapes, not dead nodes.
`model_pins.py` carries about 70 lines of incident history in its docstring.
Fix
Correct the path and the pin count, drop unused pins, rename the DeepSeek file (or fold it in during task 11), and trim the docstring.
Done when each reference resolves to a real file or symbol.

For Point 10, we have a mandate for 95% test coverage, so some tests that are purely for coverage will need to stick

## Review against the PR #991 cleanup plan

### What was asked
This PR is meant to carry out the follow-up cleanup plan for the model visualizer that landed in #991. The plan has 15 tasks:

| # | Task |
|---|---|
| 1 | Remove stray repo-root files (`coverage.json`, `probe_gate_venvs.py`) |
| 2 | Remove personal Claude agents and skills (hardcoded local paths) |
| 3 | Remove Visualizer packaging leftovers; inline the `Visualizer` extra in `setup.py` |
| 4 | Stop vendoring Model Explorer's `worker.js`; fetch a pinned, checksummed release instead |
| 5 | Merge ModelUtils into the Visualizer package |
| 6 | Send every network fetch through `github.py` with the source-policy allow-list; drop the test-only env-var hook |
| 7 | Fix the 95% coverage gate on pushes to main that skip a package |
| 8 | Close CI trigger gaps for viewer assets; make `Unit Tests` and `Codecov` required |
| 9 | Build each real model once, at its pinned revision, cached across workers and shards |
| 10 | Delete coverage-padding tests |
| 11 | Consolidate the per-bugfix test files |
| 12 | Remove tripwire assertions (source-line node ids, exact counts, bug-history docstrings) |
| 13 | Move misfiled ModelUtils unit tests |
| 14 | Replace vendored Kimi and fla model fixtures with small stubs |
| 15 | Fix stale references |

The question was whether the PR does everything except #5. Two scoping decisions apply:
- **#5 is out of scope.** The PR takes the plan's fallback instead: ModelUtils stays a separate package, and a `forbidden` import-linter contract stops it importing the Visualizer.
- **95% coverage outranks suite size.** Deleting branch-hit tests would break the gate, so the size targets in #10 and #11 (about half the size, 9<E2><80><93>10k lines) are waived.
